note: 口语题库。type: read=朗读 / topic=话题独白 / interaction=情景问答 / retell=听后复述；modes 标记该题属于 quick(快速版) 与/或 full(完整版)。

questions.prompt: Good morning. My name is Li Wei and I work at a small design studio in Hangzhou.
questions.promptZh: 早上好。我叫李伟，在杭州一家小型设计工作室工作。
questions.referenceAnswer: Good morning. My name is Li Wei and I work at a small design studio in Hangzhou.

questions.prompt: Last weekend, I took the high-speed train to Suzhou and spent two days exploring the old town with my cousin.
questions.promptZh: 上周末，我坐高铁去了苏州，和表弟花了两天逛老城区。
questions.referenceAnswer: Last weekend, I took the high-speed train to Suzhou and spent two days exploring the old town with my cousin.

questions.prompt: Although remote work has become increasingly common, many teams still struggle to maintain a strong sense of connection without shared office space.
questions.promptZh: 尽管远程办公日益普遍，许多团队在缺少共享办公空间的情况下，仍难以维系紧密的连接感。
questions.referenceAnswer: Although remote work has become increasingly common, many teams still struggle to maintain a strong sense of connection without shared office space.

questions.prompt: What strikes me most about the city is not its skyline but its rhythm — the way strangers pause, how neighbours trade small favours, and how uncertainty is met with quiet patience rather than panic.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市最打动我的不是天际线，而是它的节奏——陌生人如何驻足、邻里如何互相帮小忙，以及人们如何以平静的耐心而非恐慌来面对不确定。
questions.referenceAnswer: What strikes me most about the city is not its skyline but its rhythm — the way strangers pause, how neighbours trade small favours, and how uncertainty is met with quiet patience rather than panic.

questions.prompt: I like coffee and I drink it every day.
questions.promptZh: 我喜欢咖啡，每天都喝。
questions.referenceAnswer: I like coffee and I drink it every day.

questions.prompt: If we had known how expensive the tickets would be, we might have booked them much earlier.
questions.promptZh: 如果我们早知道票价会这么贵，可能会更早订票。
questions.referenceAnswer: If we had known how expensive the tickets would be, we might have booked them much earlier.

questions.prompt: Describe your typical day. What do you usually do from morning to night?
questions.promptZh: 描述你典型的一天。从早到晚你通常做什么？
questions.referenceAnswer: I usually get up around seven, have a quick breakfast, and then head to work. In the evening I cook, catch up on messages, and go to bed fairly early.

questions.prompt: Some people say technology makes us more connected but lonelier. Do you agree? Give reasons and examples.
questions.promptZh: 有人说科技让我们更互联却更孤独。你同意吗？请给出理由和例子。
questions.referenceAnswer: I partly agree. We can reach anyone instantly, yet shallow online contact can replace deeper face-to-face time. For example, people may text in the same room instead of talking.

questions.prompt: What is your favourite place to relax, and why do you like it?
questions.promptZh: 你最喜欢去哪里放松？为什么喜欢那里？
questions.referenceAnswer: My favourite place to relax is a small riverside park near my home. It is quiet, and I like watching the water while I clear my head.

questions.prompt: Discuss whether universities should teach practical job skills or broad critical thinking. Where do you stand?
questions.promptZh: 讨论大学应教实用职业技能还是广义的批判性思维。你的立场是什么？
questions.referenceAnswer: Both matter, but I lean towards critical thinking. Job skills age quickly, whereas the ability to reason and learn transfers across careers. Ideally, courses combine both.

questions.prompt: Talk about a decision you regret and what you learned from it.
questions.promptZh: 谈谈一个你后悔的决定，以及你从中学到了什么。
questions.referenceAnswer: I once accepted a job mainly for the salary and ignored the culture. Looking back, I learned that fit matters more than a title, and I now ask harder questions early.

questions.prompt: A visitor asks you for directions to the nearest subway station. Respond helpfully and check understanding.
questions.promptZh: 一位游客问你最近的地铁站怎么走。请给予帮助并确认对方是否听懂。
questions.referenceAnswer: Sure. Go straight for two blocks, turn left at the bank, and the station is on your right. It is about five minutes on foot — does that make sense?

questions.prompt: Your colleague blames you for a missed deadline in a meeting. Respond calmly, clarify facts, and propose a next step.
questions.promptZh: 同事在会议上把错过截止日期归咎于你。请冷静回应、澄清事实并提出下一步。
questions.referenceAnswer: I understand the frustration. Let me clarify: the brief changed on Friday. I suggest we reset the timeline together and split the remaining tasks.

questions.prompt: You are at a café and your order is wrong. Politely explain the problem and ask for a replacement.
questions.promptZh: 你在咖啡馆，上错单了。请礼貌说明问题并请求更换。
questions.referenceAnswer: Excuse me, I think there may be a mix-up. I ordered a flat white without sugar, but this one is sweet. Could you swap it for me, please?

questions.prompt: In a job interview, you are asked about a weakness. Give an honest but strategic answer and defend it under follow-up.
questions.promptZh: 面试中你被问到一个缺点。请给出诚实但有策略的回答，并在追问下自圆其说。
questions.referenceAnswer: I tend to over-prepare, which once slowed my decisions. I have learned to set a hard time box, and now I ship faster while staying accurate.

questions.prompt: A foreign friend invites you to dinner at their home, but you have a food allergy. Explain it politely without offending them.
questions.promptZh: 外国朋友邀你去家里吃饭，但你有食物过敏。请礼貌说明而不让对方难堪。
questions.referenceAnswer: Thanks so much for the invite — I would love to come. I am allergic to peanuts, so could I bring a dish of my own just in case?

questions.prompt: Listen to a short announcement, then retell it in your own words.
questions.promptZh: 听一段简短通知，然后用自己的话复述。
questions.listenScript: Attention please. Due to heavy rain, tonight's outdoor concert has been moved indoors to the Grand Hall. Doors open at seven, and your original tickets are still valid. Please avoid the east entrance.
questions.referenceAnswer: Because of heavy rain, tonight's concert moves indoors to the Grand Hall. Tickets still work, doors open at seven, and people should not use the east entrance.

questions.prompt: Listen to a short message, then retell it.
questions.promptZh: 听一段简短留言，然后复述。
questions.listenScript: Hi, this is Anna. I am running ten minutes late because of traffic. Please order me a green tea, and I will see you at the table near the window.
questions.referenceAnswer: Anna called to say she is about ten minutes late due to traffic. She asked me to order a green tea and will meet me at the window table.

questions.prompt: Listen to a short report, then summarise it.
questions.promptZh: 听一段简短报道，然后总结。
questions.listenScript: A new study finds that workers who take short breaks every ninety minutes report higher focus and lower stress. Researchers suggest standing up, looking away from screens, and moving for five minutes.
questions.referenceAnswer: A study shows workers who take breaks every ninety minutes focus better and feel less stressed. Experts recommend standing, resting the eyes, and moving for five minutes.

questions.prompt: Listen to a customer service call summary, then retell it.
questions.promptZh: 听一段客服通话摘要，然后复述。
questions.listenScript: The customer says her package arrived damaged. She wants a replacement rather than a refund, and asks for delivery before Friday. The agent promises to send a new item and email a tracking number today.
questions.referenceAnswer: The customer's package came damaged. She asked for a replacement, not a refund, before Friday. The agent agreed to ship a new item and email tracking today.
